headline: KATSEYE, ENHYPEN, Joshua cameo in 'K-Pop: The Debut' trailer
sub: Paramount and HYBE America's K-pop film opens Feb 26, 2027

points.title: Idol cameos
items: SEVENTEEN's Joshua makes his acting debut
ENHYPEN's Jay and Jake sit on the judging panel
Also: Hwasa, Sandara Park, Tablo, ILLIT

caption:
The first trailer for 'K-Pop: The Debut' is out, and it's packed with idol cameos.

Ji-young Yoo plays Lizzy, a Korean-American student who skips medical school to compete on a global survival show to form a new girl group, with Eric Nam as her mentor. KATSEYE appear as themselves, SEVENTEEN's Joshua makes his acting debut, and ENHYPEN's Jay and Jake join the judging panel. The Paramount and HYBE America film opens in US theaters Feb 26, 2027.

📌 Source: Paramount Pictures
